reviews.review: The instructions are not necessarily accurate for every computer. For example, trying to use the arrow keys to switch between tiles, as suggested in the key bindings instructions, was not working. It has the potential to be a great game, just needs to ensure that all the recommended keys work during the game.
reviews.developer_response:
Thank you very much for your feedback! 🙏 Normally, the arrow keys become available after collecting the Götterfinger effect. Could it be that this might have been the case? If they still didn’t work even with the effect active, I’d love to know so I can look into it further. Thanks again for pointing this out and for your encouraging words about the game!

Edit: I now understand where the confusion may be coming from. The explanation of when the arrow keys are available was further down in the instructions, which can easily be missed. I’ve added a clearer note at the top so players can see it immediately. Thanks again for pointing this out!
